name: Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice
description: A simple and flavorful fried rice dish made with cooked rice, beaten egg, soya sauce, and mixed vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Bring water to a boil. Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in water. Add rice, salt, and butter. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Drain rice in a strainer for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok or frying pan. Add beaten egg and soya sauce. Cook until just setting.
Add cooked rice and vegetables to the egg mixture. Stir continuously until combined.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and additional soya sauce if needed.

keywords: chicken fried rice, vegetable fried rice, Chinese-Canadian side dish

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Chinese Rice Salad
_similar.description: A flavorful salad made with Minute Rice, frozen peas, chopped celery, and a savory dressing, optionally garnished with chow mein noodles and shrimp.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cooked rice, frozen peas, chopped celery, and onion in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the dressing ingredients (oil, soy sauce, malt vinegar, curry powder, salt, and sugar).
Pour the dressing over the rice mixture and toss to combine.
Garnish with chow mein noodles and/or add drained shrimp if desired.

_similar.keywords: Chinese rice salad, savory salad, Minute Rice

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Chicken
_similar.description: A savory stir-fry dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and a flavorful sauce, served with cheesy buns.
recipeIngredient: Mozzarella cheese and bacon bits for buns

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil and garlic clove in a pan. Dip bun halves in hot oil, then place on a cookie sheet. Cover with mozzarella cheese and bacon bits. Broil 3 to 4 minutes.
Cube chicken breasts and brown in the pan. Add mushrooms, celery, onion, and Oriental vegetables. Cook thoroughly.
Make a well and add curry powder, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, Louisiana hot sauce, and Tabasco. Cook.
Add 1 cup water (or more as needed) to the vegetables. Mix cornstarch with water to thicken the sauce.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture over steamed rice with the cheesy buns.

_similar.name: Beef Broccoli Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry of beef sirloin and broccoli in a savory soy and oyster sauce mixture.
recipeIngredient: ¾ lb sirloin steak, sliced into 1/8 inch thin strips

recipeInstructions.text: Stir soy sauce into cornstarch in a small cup. Add oyster sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir and set aside.
Heat wok to medium-high. Add the first amount of cooking oil. Add broccoli and stir-fry for 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Transfer to a bowl.
Add the second amount of cooking oil to the hot wok. Add beef strips and stir-fry until desired doneness.
Add broccoli back into the wok. Stir the cornstarch mixture and pour into the beef mixture. Cook until boiling and thickened.

_similar.keywords: beef stir-fry, broccoli, soy sauce, oyster sauce

_similar.name: Chicken with a Chinese Accent
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a Chinese-inspired flavor profile, featuring soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry chicken breasts in a frying pan with oil and soya sauce until the outsides are done.
Transfer the chicken to a casserole dish.
Mix the remaining ingredients with soya sauce and pour over the chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°F.
Serve the chicken with rice.

_similar.keywords: Chinese chicken, sweet and savory, baked chicken
